paragraph: The 2015-16 Cleveland Cavaliers went 57-25 and finished 1st in the East, 4th in net rating over the regular season (+6.3 per 100 possessions). After the All-Star break they were 2nd (+6.3, unchanged), and in the playoffs +9.5, 3.2 better than the regular season. The top eight by playoff minutes: 2 drafted, 3 traded for, 3 signed; average age 28.0, the oldest 35.6; 7 of the eight had played for the franchise the season before and returning players took 86% of the playoff minutes. Those eight missed 88 regular-season games between them and 2 of the 21 playoff games. The top five's share of the minutes went from 59% in the regular season to 71% in the playoffs. No in-season move touched the top eight; the roster that started in October was the one that won in June.
